precision_label_definitions.TARGET_CONFIRMED: The citing case opinion body contains an explicit reporter citation (official, nominative, or recognized parallel citation) that resolves unambiguously and directly to the exact target case, confirmed by reporter volume/page and corroborating case title or surrounding opinion context.
precision_label_definitions.CITATION_PRESENT: A reporter citation matching the target's volume/reporter/page appears in the citing text, but occurs within a quotation of a third case, an unverified string citation, or a statutory/procedural reporter where target identity cannot be conclusively confirmed as a direct precedential citation.
precision_label_definitions.ABSENT: Neither the target's official citation, nominative citation, nor any recognized parallel citation appears anywhere within the opinion text of the citing case (false positive extraction by eyecite).
precision_label_definitions.AMBIGUOUS: The citation string appears but is ambiguous (e.g. multiple distinct cases sharing the same reporter volume and page, short-form citation that cannot be definitively resolved, or companion case with identical citation).
precision_label_definitions.UNREADABLE: The citing case's raw file is corrupted, unparseable, or contains empty/garbled opinion text such that citation presence cannot be evaluated.

sampling_specification.strata_definition: Decade of citing case (source node) decision_date
sampling_specification.missing_file_handling: Deterministic next edge in same decade stratum (by ascending index in EEG edge list) if any sampled edge source file cannot be read, with logged provenance.
